description:
src/main.rs has grown to 1,580 lines, with over 1,000 lines (lines 571-1580) dedicated to inline unit tests and 24 repetitive fixture test functions. Extract core modules, validation, and decision formatting into src/lib.rs, keep src/main.rs as a focused CLI entrypoint with CLI-specific unit tests, and move all provider fixture assertions into an integration test suite at tests/fixtures.rs.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Cargo builds both lib (src/lib.rs) and bin (src/main.rs) targets cleanly.
2. Core types (types), HTTP client (client), request validation (validate_request, parse_json_payload), and decision formatting (build_decision_value, score_decision_label, print_decision_summary) are exposed from src/lib.rs.
3. src/main.rs contains only CLI argument parsing, entrypoint orchestration, and unit tests for CLI flag resolution/parsing.
4. All 24 live fixture assertions (req_1..req_10 and req_ping across typesafe and openrouter) live in tests/fixtures.rs as Cargo integration tests.
5. cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo fmt --check pass with 0 warnings.

agent: gemini-4-argon (antigravity)
title: Decompose src/main.rs into library crate and integration fixture tests
